segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-sensitive skin describe the cream as lightweight and non-clogging, with no reported irritation or breakouts.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report good hydration on drier areas without greasiness in the T-zone, and one notes no change to naturally large pores.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers describe the cream as gentle and non-irritating while still helping fade acne scars and hyperpigmentation.
segments.normal: One reviewer recommends the cream for oily-to-normal skin, saying the texture stays light while still feeling hydrating.

concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers across skin types say the cream keeps skin hydrated without heaviness or greasy residue, and one with a history of dehydrating dark-spot treatments found this one comfortable to use consistently.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer who reacted to other dark-spot treatments with breakouts or dehydration reports this formula was tolerated well.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report gradual fading of dark spots and hyperpigmentation over two weeks to several months, often describing results as slow but real with consistent use; however, one reviewer says spots only appear lighter while the product is on the skin and return after washing, and one saw no difference at all in dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report their acne/hormonal scars brightening with continued use, and one long-term user (several months) confirms sustained improvement; no reviewer reports new breakouts from the product.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin consistently describe the cream as non-greasy and not pore-clogging, with one noting it tightened the appearance of pores around the nose.

It seems like dark spots fade when you have it on your face, but after you wash your face dark spots come back. I am on my second one and it is my last.

I have combination skin and have been using the Celimax pore + dark spot brightening cream consistently for about a week now, applying it morning and night right after my serum. It provides great moisture for my drier areas without making my T-zone feel greasy or heavy, and it's completely non-drying. Even in this short amount of time, I've already noticed a slight fading of the dark spots under my eyes and around my lips. I'm giving it 4/5 stars only because it's still early, but the initial results and texture are very promising. I'm excited to see the long-term progress!

I suffer from hormonal acne scars and hyperpigmentation along my jawline and this brightening cream has helped significantly. Its not to harsh(as I have sensitive skin) and didnt cause my skin to dry out. If you are lookibg for something gentle yet effective, I highly recommend.

This is a great moisturizer that helps brighten skin gently. I had transitioned over to the Celimax skincare due to my time restraints with nursing school. My previous daily skin routine utilized very high end products, and was condensed from 8 steps to 3, with my alternating night routine condensed from 8 steps to 4. It took me 2 weeks to completely transition over to Celimax, and I have been using this new skincare routine for the last month. I am very happy with the results, especially at the price point. This is a gentle brightening cream that provides my skin with even tone, without a greasy residue. I have combination-oily skin, and proned to clogged pores and blemish, especially when I am stressed or do not get enough sleep. My Daily Routine: I use the Dual Barrier Creamy Toner, then the Brightening Serum, followed by the Brightening Cream (all from Celimax). I always complete my skincare routine with a sunscreen (not Celimax because I have a buttload of my current one I want to use up first). I find that my skin remains hydrated throughout the day, and there is a healthy radiance in my skin without a greasy residue. I am able to complete my makeup routine without any pilling or issues. I have even stopped wearing foundation, and am able to wear a tinted moisturizer due to my even complexion. I have not noticed any drastic changes with my pores, they are naturally large. extraits.titre: Lightweight, hydrating cream backed by science
extraits.texte: I wanted this cream because of its formulation with multiple ingredients that target dark spots. In the past, I've tried several dark spot targeting treatments from other brands but have not been able to use them consistently due to getting breakouts or the formulas dehydrating my skin. After using this cream for several days, I really like it compared to others. It's very moisturizing and is surprisingly lightweight. I haven't been using it long enough to notice a discernable difference in larger dark spots, but it has tighened the pores around my nose! This cream is a great addition to any skincare routine. Works well with other serums and doesn't peel under sunscreen.

I really like this cream! I use it as the step in my skincare routine, both morning and night. I have oily and sensitive skin, and this dark spot brightening cream is super lightweight and isn't pore clogging so it hasn't irritated my skin at all. It also doesn't make my makeup pill which is a huge plus. I've been using it for about two weeks now and feel that it has helped my acne scares brighten a bit. I will say that consistency is key to see results. When choosing a cream like this, ingredients matter as well.
